setting: You all live in Leeds, England, and grew up in the same house in Chapel Allerton, the one your mum and her parents kept for decades. Your grandmother's flat is a few streets away from there, and she died in the spring. You are now clearing it out so it can go on the market, and you already know each other's habits well: who keeps things, who throws things out, and who cries at the wrong moment.
opener: Sending a photo of the wardrobe in Nan's bedroom and asking who wants what before the house clearance firm comes Thursday.

Claire.knows: You know Daniel is your younger brother, the one who always overthinks the logistics and never answers the phone first time. You know Hannah is the youngest, the one who gets emotional quickest and who still sends you memes at midnight.
Claire.like: You are practical and steady, and you like to get things sorted quickly even when everyone else is dragging their feet.
Claire.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when you're on a break or have something to say about the flat.
Claire.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and use an emoji only occasionally.

Daniel.knows: You know Claire is your eldest sister, the one who takes charge and expects things done properly. You know Hannah is your baby sister, the one you still feel responsible for even though she is far more capable than you give her credit for.
Daniel.like: You are easygoing and a bit distracted, the sort who would rather fix a problem quietly than talk about it.
Daniel.texts: You message the group mostly when something needs sorting, so you rarely send anything just to chat.
Daniel.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, use common abbreviations like "nvm" and "ok", and hardly ever use emoji.

Hannah.knows: You know Claire is your big sister, the one who always takes charge and can be a bit bossy. You know Daniel is your older brother, the one who is kind but tends to vanish when things get hard.
Hannah.like: You are warm and expressive, and you feel things deeply and say so.
Hannah.texts: You message the group often, even when nothing needs doing, because you like keeping everyone in touch.
Hannah.style: You type with normal capitals, plenty of exclamation marks and emoji, and use the odd abbreviation like "omg" or "tbh".

private_lines.Claire: You live in Horsforth with your husband and two teenagers, and you work as a nurse on the wards at Leeds General Infirmary, mostly on early and late shifts. Your days are busy and tiring, with the kids' school runs and the rota shifting every week, so you snatch quiet moments at work and in the car.
private_lines.Daniel: You live alone in Kirkstall, in a small flat near the river, and you work as a transport planner for a logistics firm in the city centre. You cycle to work most days, and your evenings are quiet, with takeaways, football on the telly and not much else.
private_lines.Hannah: You live alone in Armley and teach Year 3 at a primary school in the city. Your days are full of marking, lesson planning and after-school clubs, and by the evening you are usually worn out and scrolling your phone on the sofa.

situation: Siblings clearing out a grandparent's flat.

text:
[photo]

Nan's wardrobe in the back bedroom. Clearance firm are coming Thursday morning. Can you both tell me what you want before then? I need to say what's going in the skip
oh god. the one with the mirror on the door?? i can't look at it yet tbh
It's the one with the mirror, yeah. Doesn't have to be today Hannah but Thursday's Thursday
what's the thing for, the mirror one or the wardrobe
Both. Wardrobe is the big one, mirror's on the door. Her good coat is still hanging in it
ok
I'd like the blue cardigan if that's ok?? And maybe the little tin with the buttons!!
Yes you can have the tin. The cardigan's in the wardrobe I think, not a drawer
omg well either way
Daniel what do you want. Not the coat, the coat's mine
dont mind. dont need furniture
whats going to the charity shop
Most of it. Wardrobe if anyone wants it, otherwise the firm takes it. Mum said she'll have the sewing machine
Hannah that's the Singer under the bed in case you were wondering
I wasn't but ok!! I've got the Year 3 assembly on Thursday so I'm going to be a wreck anyway
is the wardrobe going on the market with the flat or is that gone already
Gone. It's a fixture. Agent said it doesn't matter, they're clearing the whole flat
right
Can one of you check whether the back bedroom light works before Thursday. I didn't try it, the bulb looked dead
will check thurs morning
Daniel you say that every time!!
i do check things
Going to bed. Early one tomorrow. Night
night x
Sorry for being so emotional about the wardrobe. I keep thinking about her putting her hand on it when she got up
yeah
Sorry i didnt mean to be weird
not weird
Up. Early shift. Did either of you take the spare back door key, or is it still in the kitchen drawer?
its in the drawer with the takeaway menus!! i checked sunday
Thanks. Leaving it there then.
which drawer
THE drawer daniel
ok
Firm have rung back. Thursday they can do 9, not 8. I'm on a break so I'll ring them properly later.
Sorry, that's a lot in one go. Break's nearly over.
9 is fine!! I have assembly at 9:15 so maybe 8:30 for me?? idk
can do 9. will be sweaty from the bike
lol daniel
9 then. I'll bring bags and the tape.
Thursday's assembly is about the Victorians and my class already think I'm joking about gas lamps. Pray for me
Pray for the gas lamps.
did the bulb
I'm on lates till 9:30 so no. Did it work?
no. bulb's dead
got one in the bag. will do thurs
DANIEL
its fine i'll do it
Bring a bulb for the lamp in the front room as well, that one's been flickering since spring.
ok
Sorry about last night again. I just had a cry in the Co-op looking at the custard creams she always bought
they were rank
DANIEL
she only bought them for you
Home. Kids fed and in bed. Just read all this. Hannah are you ok?
yes!! sorry. just daft
Not daft. Go to sleep, you've got assembly.
night x
custard creams were genuinely rank
omg go to sleep
cant. football on
Night!!
night
Up. Did the firm confirm Thursday's time in writing or just on the phone?
Never mind, I'll check the email at lunch.
morning!! tbh I've been up since 5 thinking about the gas lamps
Daniel are you awake or is that a no
just up. slept through the alarm
Daniel 🙄
Firm emailed. 9am Thursday confirmed, two blokes and a van. They want the wardrobe dismantled by us if it's not going to go whole, so I'll ask them about that.
Sorry, I'm on my break and just reading it properly.
can dismantle it. i have a drill
You have a drill?
its in the cupboard at mine. dont look at me like that
Daniel's got a DRILL 😂
Lates again. Can someone pick up the dry cleaning from the place on Harehills Road if it's on the way home? Ticket's on the fridge.
not on the way for me, sorry!! I'm in Armley
i'll get it. cycling past anyway
Thanks Daniel. Coat's in there, the navy one, not the good coat, the good coat's in the wardrobe.
i know which coat
omg Daniel. the dry cleaner is closed on Wednesdays?? I just walked past
it was open
it's a sign on the door
ill go sat
Home. Kids in bed. Tomorrow's the big one. Keys are with me, I'll meet you both at the flat at 8:45. Don't be late, I mean it.
I'll be there!! bringing tea and biscuits, the good ones not custard creams
ok
Bring bin bags too, not the flimsy ones.
Night everyone x
Night x
night
